analysis.note: Every failure observed is reproduced on the 0.10.21 reference and is recorded as baseline-only. No failure is attributable to FEAT-2. That is a real result, but it is NOT certification: a cell that fails for a pre-existing reason still has no passing evidence, so it still blocks AC12.

release_blockers.detail: CPython 3.14 incompatibility: dataclasses.Field.__init__ gained a required 'doc' parameter in 3.14, and datamodel/fields.pyx does not pass it, so EVERY model definition raises TypeError: Field.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'doc'. VERIFIED IDENTICAL on the 0.10.21 reference built for 3.14, so it is PRE-EXISTING and not a FEAT-2 regression -- but it means the FEAT-001 release matrix claims a CPython 3.14 that does not work at all. RELEASE BLOCKER, outside FEAT-2's scope to fix.

release_blockers.detail: rs_parsers-absent gap: `uv pip install -e .` does not build the Rust extension, so converters.pyx:199,236 dereference rc.to_date/rc.to_datetime on a module that defines only HAS_RUST=False and every string->date conversion fails. Characterized in TASK-7 and confirmed shared with the 0.10.21 reference (identical call sites). TASK-8 showed building rs_parsers makes the suite fully green. NOT a FEAT-2 regression.
